login.title: Log in
login.host_help: A host name, an IP address, or the directory of the server's UNIX socket.
login.maintenance_db_help: The database to connect to first. Leave empty to try postgres, template1 and the role's own database.
login.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

servers.title: Saved servers
servers.name: Name
servers.none: No servers are saved yet: a server is saved when a login to it succeeds.
servers.removed: {{server}} has been removed from the saved servers.
servers.remove_what: Remove {{server}} from the saved servers? The login page will no longer offer it.
servers.export_help: Downloads servers.json in pgAdmin's server import format: name, host, port, maintenance database, username and SSL mode, never a password.
servers.import_help: A file exported here or by pgAdmin (Tools › Import/Export Servers). A server at a host and port already saved is updated; groups are not kept.
servers.credentials_first: Enter the username and password above first.
servers.login_needed_rename: Changing the saved servers needs a login: {{server}} is renamed once {{username}} has logged in to it with the password above, and you go on into phpPgAdmin. Leave the name empty to take it away.
servers.login_needed_remove: Changing the saved servers needs a login: {{server}} is removed from the list once {{username}} has logged in to it with the password above, and you go on into phpPgAdmin.

errors.login_disallowed: Login disallowed for security reasons: this server does not sign in superuser names or empty passwords.
errors.invalid_preferences: The preferences must be an object of keys and values.
errors.unknown_server: That saved server no longer exists.
errors.name_too_long: A server name has at most {{max}} characters.
errors.import_invalid: The file is not a server list: it needs a "Servers" object, as pgAdmin exports it.
errors.import_entry: Server "{{key}}" of the list cannot be imported: {{reason}}
